command:
set -eu
test ! -e /opt/odin-packaging-notices-02
test ! -e /opt/odin-transfer/notices-package-job.exit
cd /opt/odin-transfer
curl --fail --silent --show-error http://10.0.2.2:47652/odin-f5878bf.bundle -o odin-f5878bf.bundle
curl --fail --silent --show-error http://10.0.2.2:47652/odin-f5878bf-source-sha256.json -o odin-f5878bf-source-sha256.json
sha256sum --check <<'EOF'
40c85c21a1079b0f5d5bd6dc7339989f64b4a55b7e30b409ccd9166086c7518b  odin-f5878bf.bundle
fa6aa33f6b0b9a473a30c0ec8d339bbbd7427f8e0c230960e0039c3fe63ad1cc  odin-f5878bf-source-sha256.json
EOF
test ! -e odin-notices-02-source-sha256.json
cp -p odin-f5878bf-source-sha256.json odin-notices-02-source-sha256.json
runuser -u odin-qa -- git -C /opt/odin-linux-0fe03ba bundle verify /opt/odin-transfer/odin-f5878bf.bundle
install -d -o odin-qa -g odin-qa /opt/odin-packaging-notices-02
runuser -u odin-qa -- git clone --quiet --branch build/packaging-notices-source-f5878bf /opt/odin-transfer/odin-f5878bf.bundle /opt/odin-packaging-notices-02
runuser -u odin-qa -- python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
tree=pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-packaging-notices-02')
manifest=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-transfer/odin-notices-02-source-sha256.json').read_text())
assert manifest['revision']=='f5878bfa725db8c0dcab7e45ca3cf89159508975'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=tree,text=True).strip()==manifest['revision']
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=tree)
for row in manifest['files']:
    data=(tree/row['path']).read_bytes()
    assert len(data)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],row['path']
before=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-transfer/odin-0fe03ba-source-sha256.json').read_text())
product=lambda name:name.startswith(('crates/','schemas/','dashboard/','scripts/','packaging/','tests/')) or name in ('Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','rust-toolchain.toml')
left={r['path']:r['sha256'] for r in before['files'] if product(r['path'])}
right={r['path']:r['sha256'] for r in manifest['files'] if product(r['path'])}
assert left==right and len(left)==99
notice=tree/'docs/THIRD_PARTY_RUNTIME_NOTICES.txt'
assert len(notice.read_bytes())==420502 and hashlib.sha256(notice.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='3909eadeb6220801da62ebfe18b7335639dcc2ebb49c1f05d916cc91d575f246'
assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-delivery/v3-notices-02/odin').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='e64c9a9e575b8d430f83acabd9a1b7503c9a1e7ed88ecd6215a0ca1bf33fba42'
report={'status':'PASS','app_build_revision':before['revision'],'packaging_revision':manifest['revision'],'packaging_files_checked':len(manifest['files']),'product_files_equal':len(left),'runtime_notice_sha256':hashlib.sha256(notice.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'app_binary_rebuilt':False}
pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-delivery/v3-notices-02/packaging-source-stage.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report))
PY
